scope: Native 3D pfm_manifold for ball, cuboid, capsule, cone, cylinder, indexed convex polyhedron and triangle
tolerance_reason: Conversion is bit exact, as are contact counts, readonly storage and guards. Normals, distances and contact planes use 2e-6/2e-5. Nonunique contact coordinates may differ by at most 1e-4 in these unit-scale fixtures only when BOTH results lie inside both original shapes. At exactly coincident independently centrally symmetric shapes, opposite normals require reflected contact points under the original strict tolerance. Raw differences remain reported; approximate native secondary witnesses never unlock relaxed coordinate comparison.
preconditions: Finite supported convex shapes, valid indexed faces, normalized relative poses, nonnegative predictions and native-exported ABI
Each invocation owns its output row; subshape conversion and contact generation are ordered device stages with resident buffers
invariants: Exact converted shapes, border radii, valid flags and contact cardinalities
Nonempty manifolds have finite unit normals, in-shape primary points and distances within independent support/prediction bounds
No regression in secondary-witness containment; remaining native misses are reported per pair and point
No host physics between conversion, GJK/EPA and clipping
outside_scope: Deferred mesh/polyline narrow-phase, production scene integration and broad collision stability qualification
Ascend vendor compilation, device execution and performance
reference_limitations: Bounded GJK/EPA may fail and return no contacts; zero-dimensional native fallback is retained
Native feature approximations and edge clipping can produce reconstructed secondary witnesses outside the second shape; these cases retain strict numeric comparison and explicit diagnostic lists
Backface fallback points outside the finite triangle are rejected in Rust and TileLang by change 0047; the neighboring valid speculative contact is retained.

known_gaps.description: The retained 343-pair corpus exposes native edge-clipping secondary witness misses, including cone/capsule and capsule/capsule overlap. The port preserves these under strict numeric comparison. General scene stability qualification or a paired native fix remains required.
